svg.title: Thinking Tokens per Review by Model and Effort
svg.desc: Jittered dot plot on a log(1 + tokens) scale. Opus 5.5 low: median 216, 18 of 90 with no thinking; Opus 5.5 medium: median 598, 1 of 90 with no thinking; Opus 5.5 high: median 1068, 0 of 90 with no thinking; Sonnet 5.5 low: median 303, 5 of 90 with no thinking; Sonnet 5.5 medium: median 372.5, 4 of 90 with no thinking; Sonnet 5.5 high: median 699, 0 of 90 with no thinking; Haiku 5.5 low: median 756, 0 of 90 with no thinking; Haiku 5.5 medium: median 1268.5, 0 of 90 with no thinking; Haiku 5.5 high: median 4063, 0 of 90 with no thinking.
svg.text: Thinking Tokens per Review by Model and Effort
Each dot is one review; the dark bar is the median. Zero-token reviews sit on the 0 baseline.
